name: Grey
racialFeatDescription: Add +1 to Bluff, Local Knowledge, and Sneak skills.
racialDesc: Petite humanoid aliens with large grey heads and large, almond shaped black eyes. They have no nostrils/nose, and no lips, just a thin slit for a mouth. They have been on earth for 1,000 years since their mothership crashed, and have integrated into society.

name: Human
racialFeatDescription: Add +1 to an ability score of your choice.
racialDesc: Most remaining Humans were either from a powerful family that had the money status to be able to be protected from the Fall, or they descend from Humans that were not protected but somehow lucky enough to survive.

name: Little
racialFeatDescription: Add +1 to Pick Lock/Pocket, Repair, and Sneak skills
racialDesc: Littles have a gene that has made them much more short and squat than the average humanoid. Think halflings for females, dwarves for males, but no pointed ears.

name: Mutant
racialFeatDescription: This feat includes selectable mutation options; see the full Mutation feat entry for complete descriptions and mechanical details. Choose randomly or just select your favorite (can be taken twice but not twice in a row)
mutationChoices: Claws: You have some sort of sharp appendages that are part of your limbs and gain an additional natural claw attack when available | Extra Limb: You have an extra limb such as an arm, leg, hand, or head that can make a M/U attack at -2 | Prehensile Tail: Your tail can be used like a hand for delicate tasks or attacks with a specialized weapon | Sixth Sense: You can see in darkness to 60 feet or sense tremors, scents, or invisible creatures within range
racialDesc: Some humans survived the bombs but were not ok. Over generations and generations, the people who were on the surface when the bombs fell have mutated. They were humans 2,000 years ago, and now are something resembling human. They may have strange mutations like extra or odd limbs, strange eyes or skin, etc.

name: Outlander
racialFeatDescription: An Outlander can control its chitin plating colors much like an octopus and can change them with mood or as desired. This chitin also provides a +2 to an Outlander's AC (included in Base AC).
racialDesc: From a world where what we call insects were the dominant species, these aliens fell to earth several hundred years ago and have not yet been rescued. Unlike the Greys, they are generally not accepted into what there is of society. They can come in most any color, and are unisexual - they can decide when to create and inseminate an egg.
